parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by *work done*.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: A beach ball is released from a balcony at the top of a tall building. The ball falls vertically from rest and reaches a constant (terminal) velocity. The gravitational potential energy of the ball decreases by $60\text{ J}$ as it falls from the balcony to the ground. The ball hits the ground with speed $16\text{ m s}^{-1}$ and kinetic energy $23\text{ J}$.
parts.text: Show that the mass of the ball is $0.18\text{ kg}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the height of the balcony above the ground.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Determine the average resistive force acting on the ball as it falls from the balcony to the ground.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: State and explain the variation, if any, in the magnitude of the acceleration of the ball in **(b)** during the time interval when the ball is moving downwards **before** it reaches constant (terminal) velocity.
